paragraphs: etrak sells recreation and leisure management software for organizations that run programs, facilities, and events. The software is said to function across all devices, whether the user is on a desktop or a phone.

Activity registration covers activities and programs through registration forms. Ticket sales cover event spaces and the sale of reserved seat tickets. Membership management supports various memberships and membership discounts. Facility reservations are meant to avoid double booking, set capacity limits, and give a user calendar.

The pages address whoever manages a recreation or leisure organization, and the use cases named are an HOA, little league, training gym, and theater. A dedicated support team is offered to help navigate the software and answer questions.

quote.text: Our software is your go-to resource management tool.
